# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 18 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-17 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/sd18_wizard_level17_widening.rs) to Wizard level 18 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-17 fixtures, and the same canonical school
# specialization selections (Evocation chosen, Necromancy/Transmutation
# opposed), adding only the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th/15th-level "Bonus feat" grants, and no level-19+
# progression. Two PF1 CRB primary sources (d20pfsrd and the Archives of
# Nethys aonprd.com mirror) were read directly before writing this fixture,
# fetching the full levels-16-through-19 block in one pass so the level-18
# row's neighbors were visible in context (guards against
# level-misattribution), and both agree byte-for-byte on all four rows: base
# attack bonus GENUINELY RISES to +9 (`18/2 = 9`, up from +8 at level 17) and
# good Will GENUINELY RISES to +11 (`18/2+2 = 11`, up from +10 at level 17),
# while poor Fortitude/Reflex both GENUINELY RISE to +6 (`18/3 = 6`, up from
# +5 at level 17).
# The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-18 row is
# "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/3/3/2" — up from the level-17 row "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/3/2/1" (the
# 8th-level column rises from 2 to 3 and the 9th-level column rises from 1 to
# 2); no genuinely NEW spell-level column opens at level 18 (9th is already
# the highest wizard spell level in PF1), so the specialist bonus-slot flat
# count (one bonus slot of each spell level she can cast, 1st through 9th)
# STAYS at 9 — an integer-division-free but genuinely flat coincidence, not a
# new column opening. Intense Spells' bonus-damage magnitude GENUINELY RISES
# to 9 (`max(18/2, 1) = 9`, up from 8 at level 17) via the pre-existing
# formula, not re-derived; Force Missile's uses-per-day pool stays
# level-independent and unchanged; Scribe Scroll stays recognized as an
# already-held grant.
# The level-18 "Special" column is genuinely BLANK on both primary sources
# (the Wizard's own next bonus feat lands at 20th level) — a pure ceiling
# raise on the Special column, no new pillar record is grounded at level 18
# beyond the genuine arithmetic rises on the already-grounded base attack /
# base save / Intense Spells pillars.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level18-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:18
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
